faqModal.description: These FAQs relate exclusively to the user section of the Kulturkataster, covering topics such as accounts, role and permission management (administrative rights), managing institutions, and editorial workflows (e.g., creating and maintaining profiles). General questions about the mission and benefits of the Kulturkataster, the scope of the different versions, and the methodological approach can be found in the “Info & Services” section of the Kulturkataster. The FAQs are constantly being updated; if your question is not yet listed here, please feel free to email the editorial team at info@kulturkataster.berlin.
